scope: M3.1 GOOD_ALL V6 FREEZE failure; no live retry or radio change
confirmed_defect: PrepCore.handle keeps kwargs, including borrowed mapped images, alive on a preparation exception. Its del kwargs runs only on success. mmap close can replace the original exception with BufferError. The old and repaired behaviors were reproduced using real sealed fixture buffers.
repair: A process-local opt-in PrepCore subclass releases kwargs in finally, before leaving FreezeGate. Successful preparation, checks and transaction semantics are unchanged; no success-path image copy is added. Genuine escaped views still fail closed.
diagnostics: On fatal FREEZE only, print the chained exception and retain one sealed source (at most 32 MiB) plus bounded request/error records. READY.json is the final hash manifest. A diagnostic write error does not replace the original error.

original_live_evidence.preserved_failed_frame_artifacts: Privileged semantic NPY and its metadata exist in gt_scratch_preserved. They do not contain the sealed FREEZE descriptor, depth/RGB/radar/actor snapshot or the original traceback.
original_live_evidence.limitation: The reproduced masking defect is not proof of the underlying trigger in this live frame. Another source-validation exception or a genuinely escaped view has not been excluded. Missing final worker trace alone does not establish why the worker failed to finish its finally block. Do not silently skip the frame or relax GT checks.
